limitations: Predictions only; none certifies fitness. Prior is weak (Spearman 0.17-0.18) and adds no detectable value over one-hot site identity in an optimistic random-split ridge check; this is not the assay-budget replay and says nothing about query-to-certify.

Full 1280-d per-shard embeddings (2.0 GB, 40 shards) exist only in Nebius bucket storagebucket-e003992510513182731464 (main/shards); no anonymous policy (PermissionDenied) and no access key created, so not downloadable here without another job. Committed artifacts are label-free PCA-64 projections and log-probs.
Throughput numbers are single measurements on a shared cluster; bf16 scores vary ~0.05 nats mean with batch/kernel.
orx project is a scratch repo copy under /tmp; durable record is the receipt files.
Bootstrap CIs resample variants and are descriptive only; SD over splits is not a confidence interval.
